results.title: Mr. Burton
results.overview: In the Welsh town of Port Talbot, 1942, Richard Jenkins lives as a wayward schoolboy, caught between the pressures of his struggling family, a devastating war and his own ambitions. However, a new opportunity arises when Richard’s natural talent for drama catches the attention of his teacher, Philip Burton.

results.title: Final Scene
results.overview: Six strangers meet to participate in a theater class for beginners, but the peculiar behavior of one of them soon transforms the experience into an emotional journey.

results.title: Dangerous Ties
results.overview: A doting housewife, by all appearances, conducting a fiery affair finds herself iced out when her lover's wife is diagnosed with a serious illness.

results.title: Native Land
results.overview: 1992. Independent Azerbaijan is fighting separatists in Karabakh. Journalist Miranda arrives from London to shoot a documentary about the Caucasian leopard. Fate brings her together with the scout Emil. Together, they go through severe trials, during which Miranda learns a lot about the Caucasian leopard and the tragic pages of Azerbaijan's recent history.

results.title: Unsubmissives
results.overview: Early 1990’s, south of France. Katy, Hélène, Laurence and Carole have been best friends since childhood. Now in their twenties, they find themselves struggling with hardship and limited opportunities in their sunny small hometown. Despite their challenging circumstances, they have maintained a resilient and cheerful spirit, supporting each other throughout life’s ups and downs. But their lives take a dramatic turn when Hélène, a single mother of three, receives a sudden notification that her welfare checks have been reduced, threatening her ability to support her family.Overwhelmed by this injustice and feeling powerless in the face of societal inequalities, the five women are driven by a fierce desire to change the course of their lives. They make the shocking decision to rob a bank, and soon, commit a series of increasingly daring heists.

results.title: Vinilo
results.overview: Amid her struggle with a devastating illness, a courageous mother with deep secrets and experience becomes a beacon of hope for her son. Through a delicate and emotional narrative, music becomes the guide to find the light in the darkness.

results.title: No Me Sigas
results.overview: Obsessed with going viral with her videos of ghosts and paranormal events, aspiring influencer Carla moves into a famous haunted building. There, she begins faking ghostly apparitions to gain more followers, unaware that a real evil entity resides in her apartment and will torment her until no one, not even she, can distinguish what's real and what isn't.

results.title: The Ainsley McGregor Mysteries: A Case for the Yarn Maker
results.original_title: The Ainsley McGregor Mysteries: A Case for the Yarn Maker
results.overview: Ainsley McGregor, a former Chicago criminologist, has moved back to her hometown of Sweet River, Texas, to teach criminology at the local university while also being the owner/operator of Bless Your Arts, a shop for community artists. Bless Your Arts is honoring a true Yarn Goddess, heiress of Real Wool, Ellie Mitchum who arrives with a cold demeanor before turning up cold, as in dead. At stake in the mystery is the future of Ellie's Fortune 500 company and her feuding family angling for control. As always, Ainsley relies on her brother, Sheriff Ryan, her boyfriend, fireman Jake, and the eccentric band of sleuths who masquerade as a Book Club to solve the crime. Whatever the mystery, Ainsley McGregor is always on the case.

results.title: The Wrecker
results.overview: A car mechanic's life takes an unexpected turn when his reckless brother makes a bad decision gaining the unwanted attention of a notorious crime boss.

results.title: Sukma
results.overview: Arini and her family went to a small town to start a new life, but it turns into a disaster after they find an ancient mirror in a secret warehouse.

results.title: Daniel's Gotta Die
results.overview: Billionaire Edward Powell has died, leaving his vast estate to his four adult children.  Their inheritance comes with one big catch: the dysfunctional family must spend the weekend together at the family beach house on the Cayman Islands.

results.title: Seed
results.overview: Two feral men living on Trash Planet discover a humanoid plant creature while foraging for food and supplies.

results.title: Keep your rubbish
results.overview: In the midst of a garbage strike, with mountains of trash cans around every corner, an influential TikTokeuse challenged her followers to reduce their waste by recycling and storing it at home. The #gardetespoubelles challenge goes viral, and for an influencer, it turns into an obsession.

results.title: A Family Upside Down
results.overview: The story follows a family, including three children who are driving their parents out of their minds. One morning, they all wake up inside each other's bodies.

results.title: Frend
results.overview: A masked recluse kidnaps a stranger on Halloween night, determined to turn captivity into companionship.

results.title: A-Maniki
results.overview: An elderly woman struggling with the digital world sees her routine interrupted when the television turns blue and an error message appears: "Update required." In search of a solution, she wanders through the aisles of a bazaar until, suddenly, darkness engulfs her and the metallic clang of a shutter announces closing time. She is trapped. A disturbing experience of isolation and oblivion begins.

results.title: A Chuck E. Cheese Christmas
results.overview: When Chuck E. Cheese and Friends learn that Santa Claus has never experienced a Christmas party, because he is always exhausted from working on Christmas Eve, they set out to throw a surprise Christmas celebration for Santa as a 'thank you' for all the joy he brings to the world! The party also winds up doubling as a way to save their town from the meddling of a holiday-hating evildoer.

results.title: With or Without You
results.overview: When Chloe’s ex-boyfriend torches her caravan, destroying everything inside, including her life savings, they find themselves on an unexpected road trip with a mysterious West African man named Dalu, who is also looking for a better life. On their journey through the Australian countryside, they face challenges and unexpected detours, which, lead them to discover hope and healing.

results.title: Together
results.overview: A couple in the middle of an ongoing argument find themselves in a very peculiar place under the influence of an unknown substance. This puts them in the midst of a battle between good and evil. Will their relationship survive the abyss?

results.title: November
results.overview: A dramatized account of Colombia's 1985 Palace of Justice siege combines fictional elements with historical footage, exploring themes of belief, turmoil, and lasting national trauma.
